note: Hand-authored. The archive records each behaviour as prose plus the results that established it, which a reader can follow but a program cannot. This file is the machine-readable half: for the behaviours the emulator is able to act on, it restates the same thing as a rule, keyed by the archive's own behaviour id so the two can be read against each other. A behaviour with no entry here is still shown on the site — it is simply not simulated, and the emulator says so rather than guessing. Every address and number below is copied from the cited record; nothing is inferred.

single-byte-reads-do-not-reach-every-byt.reachedBy: a read that starts earlier in the same region

bank-select-is-a-latch-that-a-program-ch.discardedNote: A triple the unit does not have is discarded whole, and the latch itself is in no readable address — so a bank left latched switches off every later program change with nothing to read that says so.
